sections.section_name: Section A - Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) / Fill in the Blanks

questions.question_text: Which technology allows household appliances, lighting, and security systems to connect to the internet and be controlled remotely?
In the context of creating advertisements, what does the term 'Target Audience' specifically refer to?
options: A) The actors hired for the commercial
B) The specific group of people the ad aims to reach and influence
C) The budget allocated for the campaign
D) The digital platform used to broadcast the ad
questions.answer: B) The specific group of people the ad aims to reach and influence

questions.question_text: What is the primary practical objective of organizing a 'Kaushal Mela' in a school environment?
options: A) To sell textbooks to parents
B) To showcase students' vocational skills and practical project models
C) To conduct annual sports tournaments
D) To perform classical musical concerts
questions.answer: B) To showcase students' vocational skills and practical project models

sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Briefly define the concept of 'Home Automation' in modern residential living. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Home automation involves connecting household appliances, lighting, and security systems to a central network, allowing users to control them remotely using smartphones or voice commands.

questions.question_text: What is the practical function of a 'storyboard' when planning a video advertisement? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A storyboard is a sequence of hand-drawn sketches or images that visually outlines the video's plot, helping creators organize scenes and camera angles before filming begins.

questions.question_text: State two primary responsibilities of the organizing committee during a school Kaushal Mela. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The committee is responsible for allocating exhibition stalls to students and ensuring smooth visitor management, including safety protocols and guiding guests through the project displays.

questions.question_text: You are assigned to set up a display stall for your vocational project at the Kaushal Mela. Describe the key steps to arrange your exhibition space to effectively engage and educate visitors. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: First, place the working model at the center for clear visibility. Use large, colorful charts with bold headings to explain the project's mechanism. Assign team roles so one member demonstrates the model while another answers visitor queries, ensuring a highly interactive experience.
